veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake before serving

steps.text: Push an almond into each prune.
Slice the eggplant lengthwise into 10 thin slices and cut each in half. Brush with the oil, soy, smoked paprika and maple syrup.
Cook the strips in a hot pan for about a minute each side until just soft.
Wrap each prune in a strip of eggplant and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the edges are crisp. Serve warm.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, assemble just before serving

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400 g), drained

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and pull into chunky pieces.
Fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, celery, chives and smoked paprika.
Butter the brioche slices and cut 16 rounds.
Toast the rounds.
Pile the filling on top.

veg.n: Queensboro Bridge bagels and carrot lox
veg.make_ahead: Carrot up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel the carrots, then shave into long ribbons with the peeler. Blanch for 1 minute and drain.
Toss the ribbons with the oil, soy, lemon juice and smoked paprika and chill to marinate.
Whip the cream cheese with the milk until light.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread thickly, then layer with the carrot, capers, onion and dill.
Cut in half and serve on a board.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the cucumbers into 1.5cm rounds and pat dry.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with the lemon juice and salt.
Beat the cream cheese with the chopped dill and lemon zest.
Pipe or spoon onto each round.
Top with a fold of beetroot, capers, a dill sprig and pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Dip up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Crumble the smoked tofu finely into the cream cheese and crème fraîche.
Add the lemon juice, dill, capers and horseradish and mix.
Slice the bagels thin and brush with oil.
Bake at 180C into crisp chips.
Serve the chips with the dip.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep well chilled

steps.text: Dice the beetroot very finely by hand and pat dry on paper towel.
Mix with the diced shallot, capers, chopped cornichons, Dijon, soy and egg yolk. Season well.
Toast the brioche slices and serve alongside.
Simmer a pot of water with the kombu, salt and the juice of half the lemon. Poach the mushrooms for 1 minute, drain and chill in iced water.
Pat dry and lay the mushrooms on the rest of the crushed ice.
Mix the vinegar with the finely diced shallot and cracked pepper.
Cut the rest of the lemon into wedges and serve with the dressing on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the rye slices and cut each into small squares.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with the lemon juice and salt.
Whip the creme fraiche with the lemon zest until it holds a soft peak.
Top each square with a fold of beetroot, a small dot of creme fraiche, a dill sprig and cracked pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water until just tender, then drain.
Dress with the soy, lemon juice and oil and leave to cool.
Warm the blini on a tray in a 180C oven.
Top each with a teaspoon of creme fraiche, a little of the lentils and snipped chives.
Serve straight away on a silver tray if you have one.
Heat the oven to 230C with a tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a floured bench and cut into rounds.
Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of plant-based pepperoni.
Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

veg.make_ahead: Uncooked up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: black vinegar and chilli oil, to dip

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the tofu, chives, ginger, soy, Shaoxing and sesame oil.
Pleat spoonfuls into the gyoza wrappers.
Fry in the rest of the oil until the bottoms crisp.
Add the water and steam with the lid on.
Serve with vinegar and chilli oil.

veg_af.make_ahead: Uncooked up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: black vinegar and chilli oil, to dip

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the tofu, chives, ginger, soy, stock and sesame oil.
Pleat spoonfuls into the gyoza wrappers.
Fry in the rest of the oil until the bottoms crisp.
Add the water and steam with the lid on.
Serve with vinegar and chilli oil.
Press the tofu dry with paper towel and cut into 2cm pieces.
Toss in the starch with salt, white pepper and five spice.
Fry at 190C in batches until crisp.
Wok-toss with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.
Soak the skewers. Toss the haloumi with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until golden on both sides, turning once.
Melt the butter with the lemon myrtle and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.
Fry the diced onion and mushrooms in the oil until well browned.
Add the lentils, soy, tomato sauce and stock. Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little water.
Cool the filling completely.
Line patty tins with shortcrust, fill, and top with puff lids.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Slice the onions.
Grill the vegetarian sausages over medium heat, turning often, and fry the onions in oil until soft and golden at the same time.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.
Bake the vol-au-vent cases until crisp.
Dice the mushrooms and fry in butter until browned.
Add the cream and thyme and reduce until thick, then fill the cases.
Slice the eggplant lengthwise into thin strips, brush with the oil, smoked paprika and salt and grill until soft.
Blanch the asparagus and wrap each spear in a strip of eggplant.
Mix the flour, yeast, warm milk, sugar and butter into a soft dough and knead briefly.
Cover and let the dough prove.
Boil the potato until tender, drain and mash.
Fry the mushrooms with the chopped onion in the oil until dry, then mix with the potato and chopped dill.
Cool the filling.
Cut the dough into rounds, fill, and seal.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Heat the vegetarian sausages in simmering water and drain.
Toss in a hot pan with the mustard and honey until sticky and glazed.
Spear each on a toothpick and serve hot.
Mix the plant-based mince with the breadcrumbs, egg and cheese and roll into balls.
Brown the balls in oil.
Simmer gently in the passata.
Put each in a slider bun with provolone and basil and grill until the cheese melts.

veg.make_ahead: Carrot and lentils up to 1 day, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the lentils until just tender, drain and dress with 1 tsp of the soy.
Peel the carrots into long ribbons, blanch for 1 minute, drain and toss with the oil, the rest of the soy, lemon juice and smoked paprika.
Warm the blini on a tray at 180C.
Top each with crème fraîche and a curl of carrot.
Finish with a few lentils and a dill sprig and pass around on a tray straight away.
Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.
Stir in the buttermilk and pat out the dough thick. Cut into rounds.
Bake until risen and golden.
Fry the smoked tofu in the butter for frying with the maple syrup until golden and glazed.
Split the biscuits warm, spread with the softened butter mixed with Dijon and fill with the tofu.
Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp, then toss with the soy.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and brush with butter.
Crisp the skins at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and the tofu and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chives.
Cut the cheddar into slabs and fold the plant-based salami into quarters.
Lay them out on a chopping board with the saltine crackers and a small bowl of pickled jalapeños. Eat straight off the board.

ingredients.item: tin hearts of palm (400 g), drained and shredded

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, soy and a squeeze of lemon.
Fold in the hearts of palm and half the cheddar, spoon into a dish and top with the rest.
Bake until bubbling.
Serve with crackers.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice and add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and soy sauce.
Top with the cold lager poured slowly, stir once and garnish with lime wedges.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice and add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and soy sauce.
Top with the cold alcohol-free lager poured slowly, stir once and garnish with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms up to 3 days, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthwise into thin strips.
Toss with the vinegar, soy, oil, coriander and pepper.
Lay on a rack over a tray and bake at 120C, turning once, until dark and chewy.
Roast the macadamias at 170C and toss with salt while warm.
Pile on a board with the dried peaches and macadamias in little bowls.
Simmer the vegetarian franks in water, then griddle until blistered all over.
Steam the buns and finely chop the onion.
Fill with the franks and top with mustard, relish and onion.
Chop the mushrooms finely. Mix with the tofu, cabbage, cornflour, ginger and soy.
Spoon into the wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides leaving the top open and add a dot of grated carrot.
Steam in batches until hot through.
Finely dice the onion, keeping half aside for topping.
Brown the plant-based mince with half the onion in oil.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin and water and simmer gently, adding water if needed to keep it loose.
Heat the vegetarian franks in a griddle pan until piping hot.
Fill the buns with the franks, chilli, mustard and the raw onion.

veg.make_ahead: Dip up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the mayonnaise, sour cream, herbs, capers, miso and lemon juice until green and smooth.
Cut the vegetables into sticks or halves.
Arrange the vegetables on ice around the bowl of dip.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a batter.
Pat the vegetarian franks dry and push onto sticks.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip in the batter and fry in batches until deep gold.
Serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthwise as thin as you can, about 3mm.
Mix the soy, vinegar, smoked paprika, sugar and pepper and marinate the eggplant in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Pat dry and lay on racks set over trays.
Dry at 90C, turning once, until leathery.
Cool and store in a bag.
Spread the bread with mustard and layer the deli slices and cheese between the slices to make sandwiches.
Butter the outsides.
Griddle under a weighted pan until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once. Work in batches.
Cut into fingers to share.
Marinate the mushrooms in the juice of 2 limes, crushed garlic, cumin and oil.
Grill hot on both sides until dark and tender.
Slice the mushrooms thin.
Warm the tortillas and dice the onion.
Fill the tortillas with mushroom, onion, coriander and salsa verde, with wedges of the other limes on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the mushrooms and cut into bite pieces.
Mix with the sour cream, chopped dill and thinly sliced red onion.
Butter the rye, cut into squares and spoon the mushrooms on top.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight

steps.text: Toss the pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds with the melted butter, soy and garlic powder.
Bake at 130C, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool before bagging up.
Finely dice the shallot and mix with the vinegar and pepper for the mignonette.
Simmer a pot of water with the kombu and salt. Poach the mushrooms for 1 minute, drain and chill in iced water.
Pat dry and lay on the rest of the crushed ice.
Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Chill overnight, up to 1 day before frying

steps.text: Melt the butter and fry the mushrooms until dry and golden.
Stir in the flour and cook briefly. Gradually whisk in the milk and cook until a very thick bechamel forms. Add the nutmeg.
Spread in a shallow dish, cool promptly and refrigerate overnight.
Shape into logs.
Dust with flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in 180C oil until golden and hot throughout. Drain.
Whisk the flour, water and salt into a thin batter and toss the florets through it.
Bake on a lined tray at 220C, turning halfway, until crisp and tender.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for the ranch dip.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce, toss through the cauliflower and bake 5 minutes more.
Season the mushrooms with salt and white pepper and toss in the potato starch.
Fry in 190C oil in batches until crisp.
In a wok, fry the sliced garlic, chilli and spring onions in a little oil, then add the mushrooms and toss well.

ingredients.item: king oyster mushrooms, cut into thick coins

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the mushrooms with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, lime zest and juice of one lime, oil and salt.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals on both sides until charred and tender.
Serve with wedges of the other lime.
Cut the haloumi into strips. Whisk the flour, beer and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and a little salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the haloumi in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, haloumi, chipotle mayo and coriander.
Cut the haloumi into strips. Whisk the flour, soda water and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and a little salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the haloumi in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, haloumi, chipotle mayo and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Boil the berry juice with 1 tsp agar and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 minutes, then pour into a lined square tin.
Chill until firm.
Boil the pineapple juice with 1 tsp agar and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 minutes, cool for 5 minutes, pour gently over and chill until firm.
Do the same with the coconut milk and the rest of the agar and sugar, and chill until firm.
Turn out and cut into neat cubes.
Serve on a white plate with a little whipped cream.
Simmer the vegetarian franks, then griddle until blistered.
Steam the buns over the pot.
Load each with a frank, mustard and relish and wrap in paper.

veg.n: Vegas strip hearts of palm cocktail

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400 g), drained

steps.text: Slice the hearts of palm into thick coins and chill in a bowl set over the ice.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish, lemon juice and hot sauce.
Serve on shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.
Slice the garlic and chilli.
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.
Toss the mushrooms over high heat until golden.
Add the butter, wine and parsley. Serve with bread for the juices.
Slice the garlic and chilli.
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.
Toss the mushrooms over high heat until golden.
Add the butter, verjuice and parsley. Serve with bread for the juices.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel the carrots into ribbons, blanch for 1 minute, drain and dress with the oil, soy, lemon juice and smoked paprika.
Butter the rye and cut into small squares.
Top each with a fold of carrot, a small spoon of creme fraiche, a dill sprig and pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in the vinegar with the sugar to pickle.
Crumble the smoked tofu.
Blitz half the tofu with the cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and pepper.
Fold in the rest of the tofu with chopped dill so it stays chunky.
Spread thick on rye crackers and top with the pickled onion.
Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the pumpkin with oil and salt.
Roast until caramelised.
Soften the diced onion and garlic in butter.
Add the pumpkin and stock and simmer.
Blitz until smooth and stir in the cream.
Toast the pepitas in a dry pan.
Pour into a warmed thermos and scatter pepitas on each mug.
Cut 12 small rounds from the brioche and toast them.
Fry the mushrooms in half the butter with the soy and smoked paprika until crisp.
Fry the quail eggs in the rest of the butter.
Put an egg and a few crisp mushrooms on each round and sprinkle with chives.

ingredients.item: small poppy seed hot dog buns

steps.text: Dice the onion and slice the tomato.
Heat the vegetarian franks in simmering water until piping hot.
Warm the buns in a steamer.
Fill the buns with a frank, mustard, relish, onion, tomato, a pickle spear and sport peppers, then finish with celery salt.
Finely chop the mushrooms, capsicum, onion and celery.
Mix the flour, baking powder, egg and milk to a thick batter, then fold in the chopped vegetables.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Fry spoonfuls until golden, in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise with lime juice and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Bring the lemonade, sugar and agar to the boil, simmer for 2 minutes, then stir in the colouring.
Pour half into four glasses and chill until just set. Keep the rest warm over very low heat.
Push the gummy sharks in, top up with the rest of the jelly and chill until fully set.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top as waves.

veg.make_ahead: Rolled and uncooked up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and tofu in a splash of the oil until browned.
Add the cabbage, carrot, spring onions and soy sauce and cook until dry. Cool the filling.
Roll a spoonful into each wrapper, sealing the edge with water.
Heat the rest of the oil to about 5cm deep and fry in batches until golden.
Drain on paper towel.
Mix the black vinegar, chilli oil and spring onion for dipping.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and add the dumplings flat side down until golden.
Add the water, cover and steam until the water is gone.
Fry one more minute to re-crisp the bottoms and serve with the dip.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can marinate up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Press the tofu dry with paper towel and cut into 24 cubes.
Toss with the garlic, chilli, zest and juice of one lime and the oil.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or griddle on high until golden and charred.
Serve on ice with the sweet chilli sauce and wedges of the other lime.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, lemon at the table

steps.text: Bring the coconut milk to the boil with half the sugar and half the agar, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into four glasses and chill until set.
Steep the butterfly pea flowers in the boiling water, strain, then boil with the remaining sugar and agar for 2 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes, then pour gently over the set coconut layer and chill until set.
At the table, squeeze lemon over the top and watch it turn purple.

veg.make_ahead: Filled and uncooked up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil two of the eggs until hard, then cool, peel and chop.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil with the cumin and paprika until browned, then stir in the lentils.
Stir in the chopped eggs and olives and cool the filling.
Cut the pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges.
Brush with the remaining beaten egg. Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Lightly oil four small round moulds.
Whisk the agar into the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla seeds, bring to a simmer and cook gently for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide between the moulds.
Refrigerate until set.
Dip each mould briefly in warm water, turn out and fan the orange peel around as legs.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until golden, then toss with the soy and smoked paprika and cool.
Whip the cream cheese with the lemon zest.
Spread onto the crackers.
Top each with a piece of mushroom, cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with the lemon juice.
Butter the rye, cut into squares and top with creme fraiche, beetroot and dill.
Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a small hollow in each.
Whip the feta with the olive oil until smooth and fill the cucumber cups.
Arrange on a platter.

veg.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Salt the cabbage, let it sit, then squeeze dry.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mix the cabbage and mushrooms with the tofu, half the soy and the ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat the edges.
Fry in the rest of the oil until crisp underneath, then add the water and steam with a lid.
Mix the rest of the soy with the rice vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 5 days, airtight

steps.text: Heat the oven to 140C. Melt the butter with the honey.
Toss the cereal, pretzels and peanuts with the honey butter.
Bake, stirring once.
Cool completely, then toss through the marshmallows.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthwise into thin strips.
Marinate with the soy, sugar and pepper for 2 hours in the fridge.
Lay on racks and dry in a 100C oven with the door ajar until leathery but bendy.

veg.n: Fan expo smoky garlic nut mix (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 5 days, airtight

steps.text: Heat the oven to 140C. Melt the butter with the soy, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Toss with the nuts and pretzels until coated and spread on a lined tray.
Bake, stirring twice, until toasted and dry.
Cool and serve in paper cups.

veg.make_ahead: Tapenade up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Pulse the olives, capers, miso, garlic, lemon juice and oil until coarse.
Break the crackers into jagged shards.
Serve the tapenade with the cracker shards.
Cut the mushrooms into thick chunks and season well.
Mix the sour cream with the cracked pepper for the dip.
Sear the mushrooms hard in the oil in a smoking pan in batches.
Toss with the butter and garlic. Serve on toothpicks with the dip.

veg.n: Val and Earl's truck eggplant jerky
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthwise as thin as you can, about 3mm.
Marinate with the soy, sugar and pepper for at least 4 hours in the fridge.
Dry on racks in a 90C oven with the door ajar, turning once, until leathery.

veg.n: Chang's Market spiced nuts and rice paper crackling
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

steps.text: Break the rice paper into large pieces.
Heat the oil to 190C and fry the pieces a few at a time for a few seconds until puffed and crisp.
Drain and toss with half the salt and the chilli flakes.
Toss the peanuts with the honey, cayenne, the rest of the salt and 1 tbsp of the frying oil.
Roast at 180C, stirring once.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, airtight

steps.text: Melt the butter with the marshmallows over low heat.
Stir through the puffed rice until coated.
Press firmly into a greased ring mould.
Set, then turn out and cut into wedges at the table.
Toast the marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under the grill until golden.
Squash each between two biscuits with a square of chocolate.
Leave briefly so the chocolate melts.
Dissolve the salt and sugar in the water and soak the whole mushrooms for 30 minutes.
Pat dry, score the caps in a criss-cross and brush with the oil.
Roast at 200C until golden and tender.
Mix the honey and mustard, brush over and roast until glazed.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble just before serving so the crackers stay crisp

steps.text: Lay the crackers out in rows of five.
Top each row with a different note: cream cheese, mushroom pâté, cheddar, beetroot with dill, and fig.
Serve straight away.
